description: Teardrops on My Guitar is the original teenage yearning song and it's so cute but also SO country I can't 😭💅 The Drew drama is adorable in hindsight, like baby girl you were 15 writing about a guy named Drew who didn't notice you. It's iconic for the nostalgia but the fiddle and the twang is a lot. Respect the origin story but it's not my vibe ✨
